blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – Police are investigating the killing of a 38-year-old woman who was shot by two unidentified motorcycle-riding men in Majayja, Laguna, on Wednesday night. The victim, a resident, was found lying in a waiting shed in Barangay Villa Nogales at around 7:15 p.m., the Calabarzon police said on Thursday. She was rushed to the Majayjay Medicare Hospital for treatment but was declared dead on arrival. Police did not provide other personal information about the victim.
